records.part: Photocatalytic reactor system (advanced oxidation) to destroy nitrate esters and organics in recirculating process-water for annealing air pollution control system
records.reason: Purifics has a deep knowledge and expertise of our system and its requirement as they were the company that designed and built the legacy pollution control system.

records.part: Ceramic Ultra-Filtration unit within the Photo-Cat AOP+ reactor for maintaining catalyst concentration
records.reason: The proprietary Purifics Photo-Cat® AOP+ reactor system includes a patented Ceramic Ultra-Filtration (CUF®) unit. This filtration is important for keeping the proper catalyst concentration within the reactor system flow passages.

records.part: Reverse osmosis system to remove dissolved salts from potable water utility make-up water source
records.reason: Each reverse osmosis system will be a Veolia LT4-2 model capable of producing 2.00-GPM of RO water from 2.67-GPM of potable water or an off-the-shelf equivalent capability system as determined by the NSWC IHD
